note: Canvas menus for #48, Obsidian 1.14.5 (installer 1.13.7), tools/obsidian-probe/canvas-menus.mjs. Read with 'Observed canvas menu behavior, Obsidian 1.14.5' in docs/scoria/Specification.md. Steps context-multi, context-unselected-card and context-mixed-selection are NOT evidence: the helper presses Escape to dismiss a previous menu and Escape clears the canvas selection, so each of them records a single-card case. context-multi-escape shows both orders; context-selection-rules answers those three questions without an Escape, and is the one to cite. Some steps were re-run with ONLY_STEPS against the same fixture, so startedAt is the last run's.
